violation_type.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications (26 TAC §744.1331(b)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications
violation_type.typical_finding: Two staff were trained by other employees of the operation and three training certificates did not include the trainers qualifications, in compliance with 744.1319 of this division.
